text: CHALLENGE const compose = (...fns) => fns.reduce((f, g) => (...args) => f(g(...args))); const pipe = (...fns) => fns.reduce((f, g) => (...args) => g(f(...args))); const add1 = x => x + 1; const double = x => x * 2; const square = x => x * x; const composed = compose(square, double, add1); const piped = pipe(square, double, add1); console.log(composed(3), piped(3));

He then shows how Solid 2.0 aims to cover the whole spectrum. Ryan Carniato
